test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Deposit
solution:
The correct answer is "**Withdraw**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A word that has the ***opposite meaning*** from another word is called an ***antonym***.
 
• An amount kept in a bank account is known as a ***deposit***.
 
• A ***withdrawal*** is the act of taking money out of a bank account.
 
• Therefore, ***withdraw*** is the antonym of ***deposit***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonym of ***save*** is ***waste***.
 
• The antonym of ***exhaust*** is ***refresh***.
 
• The antonym of ***submit*** is ***deny***.
